verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents an Alerts feature, though the evidence gives only its title. Its official MCP server can answer connection-level freshness questions such as "when was the last time my postgres connection completed a sync?" and "are any of my connections broken?", which partly covers knowing how fresh synced data is. missing for 10: per-destination-table freshness visibility, documented alerting when a sync misses its expected cadence or schedule, any detail on what Fivetran Alerts covers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
